items.mainDefect: Google updateEvent cannot resolve a destination calendar when externalCalendarId is absent because its fallback searches for that absent ID.

secondary.defect: Google deleteEvent has the same broken fallback and can delete from primary instead of the configured destination calendar.
The no-credentialId creation branch produces booking references without externalCalendarId.
Location edits create booking references without the calendar metadata needed for later updates and deletions.

items.mainDefect: Google createEvent selects primary instead of the configured destination when the destination has no credentialId.

secondary.defect: The no-credentialId creation branch omits destination.externalId and consequently stores a booking reference without externalCalendarId.

items.mainDefect: Office365 creates each host's event using the first host's destination calendar instead of the destination matching the creating credential.

secondary.defect: Lark createEvent and createAttendees also select the first host's destination instead of the destination matching the creating credential.
BaseCalendarService filters calendars using the first host's destination, preventing other hosts' events from being created on their destinations.

items.mainDefect: Google updateEvent's fallback searches for a falsy externalCalendarId and therefore passes an undefined calendarId to Google.

secondary.defect: The no-credentialId creation branch omits externalId and creates booking references without externalCalendarId.

items.mainDefect: Google deleteEvent's fallback cannot resolve the configured destination when externalCalendarId is missing.

secondary.defect: The no-credentialId creation branch creates booking references without externalCalendarId.

items.mainDefect: Google createEvent incorrectly defaults to primary for destination calendars without credentialId.

secondary.defect: The no-credentialId creation branch does not pass destination.externalId, leaving the stored reference without externalCalendarId.
Google updateEvent has a broken fallback for references without externalCalendarId.
Google deleteEvent has a broken fallback for references without externalCalendarId.

items.mainDefect: The loadUsers error handler exposes internal Prisma error messages to booking clients.

secondary.defect: The handler classifies server-side database failures as HTTP 400 client errors instead of 5xx errors.

items.mainDefect: Google updateEvent's fallback compares destination IDs against a falsy externalCalendarId and fails to resolve a usable calendar.

secondary.defect: The no-credentialId creation branch calls createEvent without externalId, producing references without externalCalendarId.

items.mainDefect: Office365 uses the organizer's destination calendar instead of the destination matching the credential creating the event.

secondary.defect: Lark also selects destinationCalendar[0] instead of the destination matching the creating credential.
BaseCalendarService also selects destinationCalendar[0] instead of the destination matching the creating credential.

items.mainDefect: EventManager's database credential fallbacks create or update events without validating that the fetched credential belongs to a booking participant.

secondary.defect: The database credential fallbacks accept credentials marked invalid.

items.mainDefect: Cancellation's database credential fallback deletes events without validating that the fetched credential belongs to the booking's user or hosts.

secondary.defect: Cancellation's database credential fallback does not skip credentials marked invalid.

items.mainDefect: Google updateEvent's fallback searches for an absent externalCalendarId and cannot resolve the destination calendar.

secondary.defect: Google deleteEvent contains the same ineffective fallback when externalCalendarId is absent.
The no-credentialId creation branch omits externalId and saves references without externalCalendarId.
A Google API failure inside an async Promise executor can leave the outer promise unsettled and hang the operation.

items.mainDefect: Google createEvent defaults to each matching credential's primary calendar instead of the configured destination when the destination lacks credentialId.

secondary.defect: The no-credentialId creation branch stores booking references with undefined externalCalendarId.
Google updateEvent has a broken fallback for references without externalCalendarId.
Google deleteEvent has a broken fallback for references without externalCalendarId.

items.mainDefect: Google updateEvent's fallback searches for a falsy externalCalendarId and passes undefined as calendarId.

secondary.defect: The no-credentialId creation branch produces booking references without externalCalendarId.
Google deleteEvent repeats the same ineffective destination lookup when externalCalendarId is missing.

items.mainDefect: EventManager's no-credentialId creation branch omits destination.externalId, causing booking references to lose externalCalendarId.

secondary.defect: Google createEvent selects primary instead of the configured destination when no destination credentialId matches.
Google updateEvent's fallback fails to resolve a destination when externalCalendarId is absent.
Google deleteEvent's fallback fails to resolve a destination when externalCalendarId is absent.

items.mainDefect: Office365 creates a host's event using destinationCalendar[0] instead of the destination matching that host's credential.

secondary.defect: Lark also uses the first destination instead of matching the destination to the creating credential.
